description: Source code for the Queue class in the quic simulator, implementing packet queueing, aggregation, and scheduling logic.

classes.name: Queue
classes.description: Represents a packet queue with aggregation and scheduling capabilities.

classes.name: Queue::AggregationAlarmDelegate
classes.description: Handles alarm events for queue aggregation timeout.

classes.name: Queue::EnqueuedPacket
classes.description: Data structure for packets enqueued in the queue with bundle info.

methods.name: AcceptPacket
methods.description: Accepts a packet into the queue, handling capacity and aggregation.

methods.name: Act
methods.description: Processes the next packet if the port is available.

methods.name: EnableAggregation
methods.description: Enables packet aggregation with specified threshold and timeout.

methods.name: NextBundle
methods.description: Advances to the next aggregation bundle.

methods.name: ScheduleNextPacketDequeue
methods.description: Schedules the next packet dequeue operation.
